Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for severe insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance must meet all of the following criteria: Suspected severe insulin resistance, or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance, as evidenced by one or more of the following: Hyperinsulinemia (i.e. fasting insulin >30microU/mL), High insulin requirement (> 2 units per kg per day or > 200 units total per day), Phenotypic features suggesting a defect in glucose/lipid metabolism: Acanthosis nigricans, Lipodystrophy/abnormal fat distribution, Xanthomata, Fatty liver, Known or suspected mutations of the insulin receptor gene, Known or suspected autoantibodies to the insulin receptor
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has type 2 diabetes and a heterozygous LDLR c.1444G>A mutation (familial hypercholesterolemia), but there is no evidence of hyperinsulinemia, high insulin requirement, or phenotypic features of severe insulin resistance (e.g., acanthosis nigricans, lipodystrophy, xanthomata, fatty liver). The LDLR mutation is unrelated to insulin receptor gene mutations or autoantibodies.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above (either affected or unaffected) must meet all of the following criteria: Biological relatives of patients in category (1) in whom a genetic cause of insulin resistance is known or suspected
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a family member of another patient in category (1); he is the patient himself with familial hypercholesterolemia, not a genetic cause of insulin resistance.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 must meet all of the following criteria: In good general health with no known active medical conditions as evidenced by medical history
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has type 2 diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, coronary artery disease, and a history of myocardial infarctions, which disqualify him from being a healthy control.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2. Subjects from Cohort 1 may be included in Cohort 2 if they meet the following ADDITIONAL inclusion criteria: Fasting glucose <100 mg/dL, HbA1c <5.7%, Fasting triglycerides <150 mg/dL, Fasting insulin <30 mcU/mL, BMI <27 kg/m2 or <90th percentile for age/sex (whichever is lower)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not eligible for Cohort 1 due to active medical conditions and thus cannot meet Cohort 2 criteria.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Current use of prescription or non-prescription medication. Certain exceptions are permitted, including topical medications, vitamins, and hormonal contraceptives. Other medications may be permitted at the discretion of the investigators
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is on metformin (a prescription medication), which is not explicitly listed as an exception (exceptions include hormonal contraceptives, vitamins, and topical medications).

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Recent (past 2 months) use of drugs or supplements that alter glucose or lipid metabolism (e.g. niacin, fish oil, red yeast rice)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of recent use of such drugs or supplements is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - History of diabetes or abnormal glucose tolerance
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented history of type 2 diabetes.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Psychiatric or cognitive disorder that will, in the opinion of the investigators, limit the subject's ability to provide informed consent/assent, or to comply with study procedures
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of psychiatric or cognitive disorders is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Pregnant or lactating
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male and thus not pregnant or lactating.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2 - Abnormal screening labs, including the following: ALT or AST more than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal, Glycosuria, Clinically significant anemia, Low eGFR (<60 mL/min/1.73m2), Any other abnormality that, in the opinion of the investigator, will increase risk to the subject from participation, or interfere with interpretation of study data
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not eligible for Cohort 1 and thus cannot meet Cohort 2 criteria.

Recap: The patient does not meet inclusion criteria for any group (severe insulin resistance, family members, or healthy controls). He is excluded from Cohort 1 due to diabetes, medication use, and active medical conditions. Cohort 2 criteria are irrelevant as he is excluded from Cohort 1.
